name: DMZ-Web
notes: Public-facing web tier + load balancer - only zone reachable from internet

name: App-Tier
notes: Application/middleware tier - reachable only from DMZ-Web

name: DB-Tier
notes: Database tier - reachable only from App-Tier, most restrictive segment

name: Mail
notes: Mail relay and mailbox servers - isolated from App/DB tiers

name: Mgmt-Infra
notes: AD, DNS, monitoring, backup proxies - management plane

name: Dev-Test
notes: Dev/test workloads - fully isolated from every production segment

name: Storage-iSCSI
notes: Dedicated iSCSI/NFS storage traffic - no routing to other segments

name: Guest-WiFi
notes: Guest wireless - internet-only, no internal access
